Round179G.interval_projected_jet_height_decay.{u_1} {H : Type u_1} [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℂ H]
  (G : Submodule ℂ H) [G.HasOrthogonalProjection] (f : ℝ → ℂ) (hf : ContDiff ℝ (↑⊤) f) (hs : HasCompactSupport f)
  (N : ℕ) :
  ∃ R,
    (∀ (j : ℕ), 1 ≤ R j) ∧
      (∀ (j : ℕ), Integrable (iteratedDeriv N fun x => ↑x ^ j * f x) volume) ∧
        ∀ (alpha : ℝ),
          0 ≤ alpha →
            ∀ (z : ℂ),
              |z.re| ≤ alpha →
                ∀ (r n : ℕ) (eta : ℕ → H ⧸ G →L[ℂ] ℂ) (psi : ℕ → H ⧸ G),
                  have c := fun i => (-1) ^ r * ∫ (x : ℝ), ↑x ^ (i + r) * f x * Complex.exp (z * ↑x);
                  have b := fun i =>
                    Real.exp (alpha * R (i + r)) * ∫ (x : ℝ), ‖iteratedDeriv N (fun t => ↑t ^ (i + r) * f t) x‖;
                  ‖z‖ ^ N * ∑ m ∈ Finset.range n, ‖(jetAction eta c m).comp (Q G)‖ * ‖(S G) (psi m)‖ ≤
                    conditionedCost G n eta psi b
